interpretation: The final V494 endpoint is qualified on every bound machine endpoint gate and causally beats its unchanged V463 parent. The earlier matched A0-A4 matrix proves a historical labeled-teacher signal, but its A0 failed absolute quality and is a different checkpoint. Splicing those facts would violate the controlling same-lineage causal gate.
decision: Do not certify Phase 3. Preregister the smallest final-lineage matched causal-control matrix with shared V463 parent, identical V480 acquisition payload and training budget, matched bridge capacity, autonomous generation, paired confidence intervals, and no final-test access.
phase2_external_blocker: 21000 blinded judgments from three independent human raters remain unavailable and are not waived.
claim_boundary: Endpoint qualification plus a rigorously identified causal-evidence gap; no Phase 3, minimum-information, final-test, or ABI-superiority claim.
